rationale: David brings a decade of hands-on experience shipping autonomous systems (drones at Skycatch, tractors at Agtonomy) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit specifically for robotics—directly relevant to Shan's work at Ruyi Dynamics on embodied AI robot hardware and industrial deployment. Their overlap spans autonomous vehicles, computer vision, and the infrastructure challenges of moving robotics from prototype to production, making them natural connectors on the physical AI frontier.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Shan — you're both working on the hardware-to-deployment pipeline for embodied AI robotics, and David's background shipping autonomous systems at scale could offer useful perspective on Ruyi Dynamics' industrial robotics challenges.
